decision: accepted as candidate; promoted as part of E27c
statement: The owner accepted E27b as a candidate, treating C1 end-to-end -3.98% against the frozen E27 median as measurement noise (single-request scheduling is identical to E27; -0.77% against the same-day E22b control), and asked for E27c on top of it. E27c, which contains E27b, was promoted.
